description: Phase 3 - Performance: Replace GSAP ScrollReveal with Framer Motion whileInView, verify Recharts is admin-only, audit image sizes, tighten Lighthouse budgets
steps: Create apps/web/components/ui/scroll-reveal-motion.tsx - a Framer Motion replacement for the GSAP ScrollReveal that uses whileInView, AnimatePresence, and the spring presets from lib/motion.ts. Should provide ScrollReveal and ScrollRevealItem exports matching the GSAP version's API.
Update apps/web/components/home/animated-categories.tsx to import from the new Framer Motion scroll-reveal instead of components/ui/gsap/scroll-reveal.

Update apps/web/components/home/animated-product-section.tsx to use Framer Motion whileInView for its section-level reveal instead of GSAP ScrollTrigger. Keep the product card animations using Framer Motion.

Note: Do NOT remove the GSAP lib or other GSAP components (AnimatedStoreName, HeroSection parallax, etc. are intentionally GSAP per AGENTS.md). Only replace ScrollReveal usage in home components with Framer Motion equivalents.

Verify Recharts imports are only in components/admin/ directory (already confirmed: admin-charts.tsx and revenue-chart.tsx only). Add a code comment in next.config.ts near the optimizePackageImports noting recharts is admin-only.

Audit and fix image 'sizes' attributes: check apps/web/components/product-card.tsx, apps/web/components/home/animated-categories.tsx, and the PDP for appropriate sizes props on Next.js Image components.
Update apps/web/lighthouserc.cjs: tighten performance score to 0.90, add a comment that these budgets are enforced by CI (Phase 0).
acceptance_criteria: New Framer Motion ScrollReveal component exists at components/ui/scroll-reveal-motion.tsx
animated-categories.tsx uses Framer Motion scroll reveal instead of GSAP
animated-product-section.tsx uses Framer Motion for section reveals
GSAP lib and other GSAP components (hero, store name, etc.) remain untouched
Recharts verified as admin-only (no customer-facing imports)
Lighthouse budget for performance raised to 0.90
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit in apps/web and confirm it passes
findings: All acceptance criteria met. tsc --noEmit passes clean. GSAP files untouched. Recharts confirmed admin-only (admin-charts.tsx, revenue-chart.tsx). ProductImage now accepts optional sizes prop for better responsive optimization. Lighthouse performance budget raised to 0.90.
